name: Moonlight Aura
body:
School evocation [light]; Level druid 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a moonstone worth 10 gp)

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area emanation centered on you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none or Will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You are surrounded by an aura of pale moonlight. For the duration, you illuminate the area to a minimum of dim light. This penetrates any darkness effect of the aura’s spell level or lower. It does not counter or dispel the effect, however.

Additionally, the aura triggers any effects set off by exposure to moonlight, like lycanthropy, unless the creature makes a Will save. Once a creature has made the Will save against the aura, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours.
